commitResults.messageBody: Document assumptions about task validity, completion state, event date ordering, parser indices, and storage record structure. Keep input validation handled through existing exceptions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor parser command dispatch
commitResults.messageBody: Separate input normalization from command-specific dispatch in Parser.parse.This makes the main parsing flow easier to understand and keeps commandselection in a focused helper method.

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace storage magic literals with named constants
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce descriptive constants for task type and completion markers inStorage. This makes the persistence format self-documenting and reduces therisk of inconsistent updates when storage handling changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reduce nesting in storage task loading
commitResults.messageBody: Extract task construction and completion-status handling fromStorage.createTask so each method has a single clear responsibility.

commitResults.messageTitle: Clarify parser argument validation
commitResults.messageBody: Replace dense multi-condition expressions in deadline and event parsing withnamed validation conditions.This makes the required description, start date, and end date checks easier tounderstand while preserving all existing parsing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reuse shared task list display logic
commitResults.messageBody: Extract duplicated list-building and printing logic from Ui.showTaskList andUi.showMatchingTasks into a shared private helper.This reduces duplication and ensures future changes to task-list formatting areapplied consistently to both commands without changing current output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve command loop variable names
commitResults.messageBody: Rename ambiguous variables in Finn.run to clarify their roles in commandexecution and loop termination.This improves readability without changing the program's behavior or output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use streams for storage task processing
commitResults.messageBody: Replace imperative loading and saving loops in Storage with Java Streampipelines.The new implementation maps storage lines to tasks, filters malformed entries,formats tasks for persistence, and filters unsupported task types beforecollecting the results.This reduces boilerplate while preserving task order, storage compatibility,and existing behavior.
